plugin.name: Work Activation Assistant
plugin.description: Review email-derived tasks, plan selected workdays, preserve unfinished work, and update NotePlan without overwriting manual changes.
plugin.author: Leslee Hyman

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Dashboard
plugin.commands.description: Open the visual Work Activation dashboard for today

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: View Workday
plugin.commands.description: Open the dashboard for a selected workday

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Refresh Gmail & Calendar
plugin.commands.description: Check Gmail and Calendar now, then rebuild the dashboard

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Scan Older Email
plugin.commands.description: Review the next bounded batch of older work email

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Build Time Blocks
plugin.commands.description: Add suggested focus blocks around the selected date's calendar

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Schedule Tasks
plugin.commands.description: Give scheduled tasks an activation date

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Review Waiting
plugin.commands.description: Review grouped dependencies and returned responses

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Today
plugin.commands.description: Refresh the assistant section for a selected date

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Capture Idea
plugin.commands.description: Capture an idea and answer one follow-up

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: System Check
plugin.commands.description: Verify the installed dashboard, cloud connection, review IDs, and native task blocks

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Import Pilot Review
plugin.commands.description: Import the completed browser pilot into NotePlan

plugin.commands.name: Assistant: Apply Dashboard Action
plugin.commands.description: Safely apply a dashboard edit in NotePlan

plugin.settings.title: Service URL
plugin.settings.description: Cloud Run URL without a trailing slash; leave empty during local pilot

plugin.settings.title: Service API token
plugin.settings.description: Private token generated during deployment; leave empty during local pilot
